patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...). Inside that directory, there will be a folder named 'www'. Download the patch archive from the link below Extract the 'img' folder from the downloaded patch archive into the 'www' folder mentioned above, merging folders and replacing files as necessary It's working if: When you encounter either the Gorgon in the Blue Dungeon or the Fallen Warrior in the Baby League of Battle Chateaux, (depending on what you fight first), they have nipples (in their scales or just under their top, respectively). uncensorpat.ch checked this patch on PC.
